title: Kalidasa Kannada Meshtru
desc: When the existence of his school is threatened, Kalidasa, a Kannada teacher who loves teaching the language, raises his voice against the education system that leans towards private schools.

title: Devil's Double Next Level
desc: A brutally honest film critic is invited to an exclusive preview of a horror-laced movie by an enigmatic filmmaker. However, events take a surreal turn when he finds himself trapped inside the film.

title: Bheema Theeradalli
desc: Chandappa, a dreaded dacoit, gets deceived by a corrupt politician, Shashikanth. But fate intervenes when the latter's sister ends up falling in love with Chandappa.

title: Milana
desc: Anjali's father forces her to marry Akash. Unable to forget her past, she demands a divorce from Akash, but soon begins to fall for him.

title: Melkote Manja
desc: Jaggesh, always in debt, finds unexpected allies among his debtors, who hilariously come to his rescue. Set in picturesque Melkote, it's a fun watch!
